compute_smooth_l1_loss: compute the smooth L1 loss between input and target tensors with a configurable beta parameter
compute_smooth_l1_loss_with_mean_reducti: compute the smooth L1 loss between two tensors and return the mean of all loss values
compute_smooth_l1_loss_with_sum_reductio: compute the smooth L1 loss between two tensors and return the sum of all loss values
compute_smooth_l1_loss_no_reduction: compute the smooth L1 loss between two tensors and return per-element loss without reduction
compute_smooth_l1_loss_l1_fallback: compute the smooth L1 loss that falls back to pure L1 loss when beta is less than 1e-5
